# Skinned sprites fixture

Fifty sprites, each deformed by two `Bone2D` entities through a `SpriteSkin` (an 8 x 2 mesh), and ten of them with an
`IK2D` on the lower bone that reaches for a moving target. One script swings the free bones and moves the targets every
frame. It is the perf case of docs/ANIMATION.md, "Bones and IK": `tests/perf/skinned-sprites.perf.json` holds the budget
(draw calls, entities) and ctest runs `factoria validate`, `factoria test` and `perf.check` on it (`fixture_skinned_sprites_*`
in `tools/cli/CMakeLists.txt`).

The scene file is generated by hand-editing JSON; keep the ids `s<N>`, `s<N>_b0`, `s<N>_b1`, `s<N>_tip` and `t<N>` (IK
sprites only: N a multiple of 5), because the script and the tests look them up.
